text:
Spotify leaked Cardi B on the GTA 6 album. Now it's real.
Last Sunday, Spotify's album page briefly showed two names on the track list. Cardi B on track nineteen. Fuerza Regida on track ten. Then the page was pulled.
Rockstar hadn't said a word. Only six songs were out.
Now both are here. Cardi B's song is called Don't Chart. Fuerza Regida dropped one called Suzuki.
That makes eight songs released so far, out of thirty-four. Travis Scott, Morgan Wallen, and Keith Richards from the Rolling Stones are already on the list.
The full album arrives November nineteenth, the same day as the game.
So the leak was right. And Rockstar still has twenty-six songs left to reveal.
Cardi B is officially in Vice City. Which artist do you want to see next? Tell me in the comments.
